The hypothesis regarding ancient Martian surface water was fully substantiated by the rover's extraction of gypsum layers. (關於古代火星地表水的假設，透過探測車對石膏層的提取得到了完全證實。)
Lichens function as pioneer colonizers by attaching tightly to the bare granite rock substrate following volcanic eruptions. (火山爆發後，地衣會附著在裸露的花崗岩基質上，成為拓殖荒地的先驅生物。)
Radar anomalies indicated the presence of substantial subsurface ice reserves near the Martian equator. (雷達異常顯示在火星赤道附近存在大量地表下的冰儲量。)
The museum curator added an explanatory text subtitle to the ancient Mesopotamian cuneiform slab display card. (博物館策展人在古代美索不達米亞楔形文字石板的展示卡上，添加了解說副標題。)
Subtractive sculpture involves carving away material from a marble block until the desired form emerges. (減法雕刻涉及從大理石塊上雕刻掉材料，直到所需的形狀顯現出來。)
The subtropic zone experiences long clement growing seasons, permitting sedentary groups to master intensive legume agriculture. (亞熱帶地區氣候溫和、生長季漫長，讓定居群體得以發展密集的豆科作物栽培。)
Subtropical biomes experience prolonged clement seasons, supporting the systematic horticulture of citrus crops. (亞熱帶生態系有漫長溫和的季節，適合系統性栽培柑橘。)

Ecologists track the successional timeline of pioneer plants that colonize barren rock zones following a volcanic event. (生態學家追蹤火山事件後拓殖荒蕪岩地的先驅植物演替歷程。)
A succulent plant thrives in hyper-arid desert biomes by utilizing specialized tissue to store rainwater resources. (多肉植物利用特殊組織儲存雨水，在極度乾旱的沙漠生態系中茂盛生長。)
The weakened patient unfortunately began to succumb to the aggressive bacterial infection despite receiving antibiotic treatment. (儘管接受抗生素治療，這名虛弱的患者仍開始受到嚴重細菌感染的侵襲。)
The vacuum cleaner relies on strong suction to remove dust from carpets. (吸塵器依賴強大的吸力來清除地毯上的灰塵。)
The local ecosystem changed suddenly when an invasive predatory fish was accidentally introduced into the lake. (當一種具侵略性的捕食性魚類被意外引入湖中時，當地的生態系統突然發生了變化。)
The island community achieved food sufficiency by developing sustainable aquaponics and vertical agriculture. (該島社區透過發展永續的魚菜共生與垂直農業，達成糧食自給自足。)

The monumental architecture of the citadel council chambers was explicitly designed to befit a suitably elite aristocrat. (城堡議事廳宏偉的建築，明顯是為了符合高階貴族的身分而設計。)
Volcanic eruptions inject sulfate particles into the atmosphere, reflecting solar rays and inducing cooling. (火山爆發將硫酸鹽顆粒注入大氣中，反射太陽光線並引發降溫效應。)

The archeologists carefully excavated the sunbaked clay tablets containing ancient cuneiform script. (考古學家仔細挖掘了含有古代楔形文字、經烈日曝曬的泥板。)

meaning: 陽光穿透雲霧、旭日形裝飾

Marine alga bladders float close to the sunlit ocean surface to maximize carbon dioxide absorption during photosynthesis. (海洋藻類的氣囊漂浮在靠近陽光照射的海洋表面附近，以在光合作用期間最大化二氧化碳的吸收。)
The graphic designer decided to superimpose the text onto the background image. (平面設計師決定將文字疊加到背景圖片上。)
Many indigenous myths attribute unpredictable weather events to the whims of powerful supernatural entities. (許多原住民神話將不可預測的天氣事件歸因於強大超自然實體的反覆無常。)

meaning: 至高無上；優勢；主導地位

The industrialization of textile outwork led to mass-produced cotton suspender straps, replacing traditional rawhide components. (紡織家庭代工的工業化帶來了大量生產的棉質吊帶，取代了傳統的生牛皮部件。)
Nomadic pastoralists drive herds across extensive steppe landscapes to secure seasonal milk and meat products for tribal sustenance. (遊牧民趕著牲畜穿越廣闊草原，取得季節性的乳品與肉類，以維持部落生計。)
The engineering crew faced severe logistical obstacles when building a roadway across the swampy terrain. (工程團隊在沼澤地形上修築道路時，遇到嚴重的後勤障礙。)

The newly elected Prime Minister promised to introduce sweeping economic reforms to reduce national debt. (新當選的總理承諾引入徹底的經濟改革以減少國家債務。)
The ancient ichthyosaur was an exceptionally dynamic marine swimmer, utilizing a fishlike tail for propulsion. (古代魚龍是一種格外強勁的海洋游泳生物，利用類似魚類的尾巴進行推進。)
The white-collar criminal orchestrated a complex Ponzi scheme to swindle elderly investors out of their retirement savings. (這名白領罪犯精心策劃了一個複雜的龐氏騙局，以騙取老年投資人的退休儲蓄。)
Intense atmospheric storms on Jupiter cause gaseous chemical layers to swirl into massive, dynamic eddies. (木星上的強烈大氣風暴使氣態化學層旋轉，形成巨大而活躍的渦流。)
The fans would swoon whenever the pop star smiled at them. (每當流行歌手對粉絲微笑時，粉絲們都會為之傾倒。)
The eagle began to swoop down from the sky to catch its prey. (老鷹開始從空中俯衝而下以捕捉獵物。)
Mycorrhizal fungi establish a symbiotic relationship with plant roots, exchanging nutrients for carbohydrates. (菌根真菌與植物根部建立共生關係，以營養成分交換碳水化合物。)
The precise synchronization of avian hatching schedules ensures that all nestlings emerge when insect food is peak. (鳥類精確同步的孵化時程，確保所有雛鳥都能在昆蟲食物供給達到高峰時破殼而出。)

The manufacturing machinery utilizes a digital synchronizer to ensure that all assembly robotic arms move in exact unison. (這台製造機械利用數位同步裝置，以確保所有組裝機器手臂完全同步移動。)
Plants utilize specific specialized organelles to synthesize essential complex starches from simple glucose molecules. (植物利用特定的特化細胞器，從簡單的葡萄糖分子中合成出必要的複雜澱粉。)
The museum features tactile exhibits designed for visually impaired visitors. (該博物館設有專為視障遊客設計的觸覺展品。)
During the academic lecture, the professor suddenly went off on a fascinating tangent about medieval history. (在學術講座中，教授突然扯開話題，聊起了關於中世紀歷史的迷人題外話。)
The bakery window displayed a tantalizing array of fresh pastries. (麵包店的櫥窗裡展示了一系列誘人的新鮮糕點。)

meaning: 織錦；壁毯；豐富多樣的畫面

The friendly tavernkeeper welcomed the weary travelers and provided them with warm food and shelter. (這位友善的酒館老闆迎接了疲憊的旅人，並為他們提供熱食與住所。)
The centralized state collected heavy agricultural taxes from sedentary farmers to fund monumental architectural projects. (中央集權國家向定居的農民徵收沉重的農業稅，以資助宏偉的建築計畫。)

The ancestral pueblo dwellers were technologically sophisticated, building multistory stone dwellings inside defensive alcoves. (祖先普韋布洛人在技術上相當先進，在具有防禦性的岩壁凹處建造多層石造住宅。)

meaning: 構造地質學；板塊構造論

meaning: 遠距通勤者、在家工作者

An invertebrate like the jellyfish uses each venomous tentacle to paralyze and capture swimming fish. (像水母這樣的無脊椎動物利用其每條有毒的觸手來麻痺並捕捉游泳的魚類。)

meaning: 恐怖地、令人心驚膽戰地

The Renaissance humanist thinker rejected rigid medieval pedagogy, prioritizing naturalism and individualistic arts. (文藝復興時期的人文主義思想家拒絕僵硬的中世紀教學法，優先考慮自然主義與個人主義藝術。)
Subsurface calcareous ooze layers are distributed thinly across high-velocity ocean floor rift boundaries. (地表下的鈣質軟泥層稀疏分布在高速洋底裂谷邊界上。)
